title: Challenger Financial Services Group Limited - proposed acquisition of AXA's Australian Annuity Portfolio

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC did not oppose the proposed acquisition, particularly because it would not reduce the number of existing suppliers of annuities in Australia.
